FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
SecureSpace Storage Solutions operates as a premier self-storage facility, providing a secure and accessible environment for individuals and businesses to store their belongings. Our facility features advanced security measures, including 24/7 surveillance cameras and controlled access systems to ensure the safety of stored items. We offer a variety of unit sizes, including climate-controlled options for sensitive items, while adhering to all local building codes and fire safety regulations.

Our dedicated staff is trained to assist customers in selecting the right storage solutions to meet their needs, and we maintain meticulous documentation of all contents stored in portable units on-site. Security personnel are present during all hours of operation to deter theft and vandalism. Additionally, we provide packing supplies for customer convenience and implement regular inspections and cleaning schedules to uphold our facility's standards.

In accordance with our operational protocols, we strictly prohibit the storage of flammable or hazardous materials and adhere to industry guidelines to ensure a safe environment for all clients.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not store flammable, explosive, or toxic substances without proper endorsements and confirms that all operations comply with safety regulations. Additionally, our self-storage facility is limited to two stories in height, and any portable storage units on-site are maintained for no longer than 90 days with the necessary documentation and fire safety measures in place.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Motor vehicle accident involving a delivery truck on 08/12/2022 caused damage to one of the storage units, resulting in an estimated loss of $4,000. The incident involved no injuries and was settled with the insurance company. Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Climate-controlled storage vault with advanced security features and fire-rated construction.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: 24/7 security personnel on-site, continuous video surveillance, and electronic gate access for controlled entry.
